asr.full_text: What's up Good evening family Univerting and now...good evening OneCoin family We are here today with Sebastian Gringo he is the master distributor of the company OneCoin Today is the 10th of November We promised to you guys that today we would have a grand opening and the time is already starting... for you to have an understanding and we are starting to transmit for you what is happening we are very happy that is happening with this fusion, with the company One Point and more than ever, the EIPOs are working and finishing the operation of the network You in the maximum Monday will have your networks all inside the One Point will have you in the login and password, and within our recovery plan Starting to end on Monday I'm very happy to hear you very happy to receive any information from this great company More than ever, day after day and all the info I am receiving from this big company I am sure you will be surprised by this meeting More than ever, day after day, This fabulous contact with Sebastien I am sure we have made the right choice Sometimes you know is not easy We are in a company, that's happening to every one of you, but wait for it. There in the future, you will feel it like we are today, because our heart is already beating telling us that this is the correct choice. One coin will make us come back in this joy and a wonderful feeling that we have of a business of a future! I would now like to give the floor to Sebastien. Thank you very much. Hello everyone, I'm Sebastien Greenwood. Master Distributor! Hello everyone, I am Sebastian Greenwood. I am the 001 distribution master at OneCoin. I have the first position in the structure of OneCoin. Today, we are just over 1,4 million people in one coin So you have taken right decision to join this Empire starting now And the reason I'm speaking to you today Is because my good friend Alexandre We have had some discussions over some period of time Here is my good friend Alexandre And the reason I'm talking to you today is because my good friends Alexandre We had some discussions over some period of time Of how we can work together Because building an empire is about working together And OneCoin as a concept that is taking over the world What we are doing together, is for you to be able to be sure that all of us as a net can grow together. It means OneCoin is now spreading all over Latin-America. And this we do when we unite the Univerteam together. When we work together, we become more and more together. We are joining as a team Well we work together become more and more powerful Together we are way, way stronger And I can tell you that so many people thousands of thousands of thousands of people in the OneCoin world are making over 35 thousand euros in commissions every week And I can tell you that many but still many people and €5.000 in commission every week. We focused on a commission plan that is simple and duplicateable. We have made it sure that people around the world, it doesn't matter if you are old or young, to make 35,000 euros per week It's a opportunity, you don't necessarily have to build a team You make money from both sides of the coin you have the capital from both sides from the money One is from the building of the coin creating the coin, mining the coin You become part of the supply of the coin You are part of the whole supplement of the coin Now with the whole group of are creating the coin together with us you will see that your value, of your portfolio is growing because the coin value is going up You'll see that when you build up the coin their portofolio starts to grow because the coin grows and you are joining us together at an early stage because we have already taken out 27% of the coins... you start with us, you give us a new step. Today we all have only 27% of the coins... But we have go all the way to 80% but our goal is to get to 80%, once we reach 80% when we have 80% outside the machines of the server, is yes, right? we will publish if you get in today, approximately the value will have its value at 5 euros When we come in public, probably the value of your coin will be at 20 euros Now it depends on if you want to create coins or not As most people have understood that creating coins is creating money Today we are sitting in Brazil Tomorrow is Friday, on. And tomorrow we are officially announcing the merge of Univerteam and OneCoin. Now is your chance... one coin, to have a chain of coins, and for each week we would make network commissions Every single week And this is an easy one-two-three four step program Where you can profit to the maximum! It's a 4 step system And you can make money in this network So I look forward to meeting all of you and to see that you actually have learnt from the 1coin system And I also want to see that you're making very very good commissions every single week I want to see you all growing, I want to know each and every one of you, and I'm going to see all of you making a lot of money in each week. Our best day of the week is Mondays, I call them… Happy Mondays! Wednesday is the best day of the week, I call it Happy Monday! Everybody gets paid on Monday! Everyone gets their payment on Monday's. So take this opportunity, listen to your network and your upline, learn from the best, and profit from the maximum. Thank you very much! Now, look ahead, learn from your master and thank you very much! Thank you! Thank you Sebastian! Learn with your master and thanks and I appreciate it! Thank you! Thank you for the service Tchan! Guys, thanks, a big hug on POI and enjoy it cause as a side, on Monday we will have our super breath plan Thanks guys, God bless you! Bye bye!

textual.observation: The speaker links joining the OneCoin network or participating in its structure with claimed weekly commissions of up to €35,000.

evidence.quote: you have taken right decision to join this Empire starting now
thousands of thousands of thousands of people in the OneCoin world are making over 35 thousand euros in commissions every week
listen to your network and your upline, learn from the best, and profit from the maximum

textual.context: The statements are presented as direct promotional claims to the audience, with participation in the network and following an upline connected to the claimed commissions.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed high weekly commissions are explicitly linked to joining the OneCoin 'Empire' and participating in its network, creating a reward claim tied to requested participation.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that any viewer paid, recruited others, received commissions, or experienced loss. The ASR contains noisy wording.

textual.observation: The speaker projects future coin values of approximately €5 and €20, linked to entering today and participating in coin creation.

evidence.quote: if you get in today, approximately the value will have its value at 5 euros
When we come in public, probably the value of your coin will be at 20 euros
creating coins is creating money

textual.context: The projected values are framed as future outcomes and include conditional or probabilistic language such as 'if you get in today' and 'probably.'
textual.potential_relevance: Future price figures are tied to a time-sensitive entry step and participation in creating coins, creating a return claim linked to a requested action.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify coin issuance, public listing, market price, liquidity, or realized returns. The ASR wording is partially irregular.

textual.observation: A speaker claims senior OneCoin authority and an official Univerteam-OneCoin merger while directing viewers to follow the network and upline for profit.

evidence.quote: he is the master distributor of the company OneCoin
I have the first position in the structure of OneCoin
And tomorrow we are officially announcing the merge of Univerteam and OneCoin
listen to your network and your upline, learn from the best, and profit from the maximum

textual.context: The role, affiliation and merger are asserted within a promotional address; the records do not independently confirm them.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed senior identity and 'official' merger are used alongside instructions to follow the network or upline and pursue profit, making the endorsement claim relevant to the requested action.
textual.limitations: The records do not independently verify the speaker's identity, position, company affiliation, or the stated merger.

textual_context_notes.observation: The material is presented as a promotional address encouraging participation rather than as a warning, report or quoted criticism.

evidence.quote: you have taken right decision to join this Empire starting now
Now is your chance

textual_context_notes.observation: The coin-value statements contain conditional and probabilistic qualifications rather than a flat unconditional guarantee.

evidence.quote: if you get in today, approximately the value will have its value at 5 euros
probably the value of your coin will be at 20 euros

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it urges viewers to join the OneCoin structure and pursue profit through its network and upline. It promotes claims of over €35,000 in weekly commissions, coin creation as a way of creating money, and projected coin values, while presenting future possibilities rather than verified outcomes. The merger and Monday-payment statements further contribute to the promotional context, although the records do not independently establish the speakers’ affiliations, the merger, coin values, actual payments, or any viewer’s participation or loss.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted earning opportunity centers on a repeatable commission plan, prospective weekly network commissions and guidance from an upline. The speaker also says building a team is not necessarily required, so the evidence does not establish that every participant's earnings depend on personally recruiting others.
